mikal_3dobject.name: 3D Object
mikal_3dobject.description: 3D Object using the gltf/glb file format.

debug.name: Debug
debug.desc: Whether debug info should be logged into the console.

instance-model.name: Instance model data
instance-model.desc: Whether each instance can have its own model data.

image-texture.name: Image texture
image-texture.desc: Use only the image texture, ignore materials and other textures.

x-scale.name: X scale
x-scale.desc: X scale (divisor, larger value makes model smaller).

y-scale.name: Y scale
y-scale.desc: Y scale (divisor, larger value makes model smaller).

z-scale.name: Z scale
z-scale.desc: Z scale (divisor, larger value makes model smaller).

worker-animation.name: Worker animation
worker-animation.desc: Offload animation to worker, useful for animated models with complex geometry.

cpu-xform.name: Worker BFC
cpu-xform.desc: Whether back face culling should be done by a worker.

use-bone-bounding-box.name: Use bone bounding box
use-bone-bounding-box.desc: When enabled, calculates bounding box from bone positions (dynamic, follows animation). When disabled, uses static model bounding box.

gpu-skinning.name: GPU skinning
gpu-skinning.desc: Skin meshes on the GPU (bone matrices computed in the animation worker). Also avoids sending vertex data to the animation worker, greatly reducing memory per instance.

distance-rate.name: Distance animation rate
distance-rate.desc: Scale the animation update rate down with distance from the camera. Multiplies the rate set by the 'Set animation rate' action rather than replacing it, so events and this can both be used.

distance-rate-min-dist.name: Rate min distance
distance-rate-min-dist.desc: Distance from the camera at or below which the animation rate is left at full ('Rate max rate').

distance-rate-max-dist.name: Rate max distance
distance-rate-max-dist.desc: Distance from the camera at or beyond which the animation rate is reduced to 'Rate min rate'.

distance-rate-min-rate.name: Rate min rate
distance-rate-min-rate.desc: Animation updates per second at (and beyond) the max distance.

distance-rate-max-rate.name: Rate max rate
distance-rate-max-rate.desc: Animation updates per second at (and within) the min distance. Also the reference rate: the distance factor is this rate's fraction of it, so a rate set by events is left unchanged at close range.

start-hidden.name: Start with nodes hidden
start-hidden.desc: Disable every mesh node as soon as the model is parsed, before its first animation update and first draw, so 'On model loaded' can enable only the nodes you want. Avoids the one-frame spike where the whole mesh list renders and animates before events hide it.

static-mesh.name: Static mesh
static-mesh.desc: Upload the mesh to a GPU buffer once and draw it with a single call, instead of submitting one quad per triangle every frame. 'Auto' enables it for models that have no animations.

node-name.name: Node
node-name.desc: Enter the name of node to check if enabled.

on-loaded.description: Triggers when 3DObject has completed loading the 3D model.

is-loaded.description: True if the 3DObject has loaded its 3D model.

on-animation-finished.description: Triggers when the animation has finished (only triggered if not looping).

on-animation-name-finished.description: Triggers when the named animation has finished (only triggered if not looping).

name.name: Name
name.desc: Enter the name of animation to check if playing.

animation-name.name: Animation
animation-name.desc: Enter the name of animation to check if playing.

set-gpu-skinning.description: Set gpu skinning (static geometry must be enabled).

set-z-elevation-0.description: Set z elevation (world z axis, depth component).

set-local-center.description: Set the local center of the 3DObject in the model files coordinate system.

set-scale.description: Set scale from original object size.

scale.name: Scale
scale.desc: The size to scale from the original size.

set-rotation.description: Set rotation of object from the original position, with rotation order.

rotation-order.name: Rotation order
rotation-order.desc: Order to rotate object around axes.

enable-node.description: Enable or disable node for render.

node-name.name: Node name
node-name.desc: Node name to enable or disable.

enable.name: Enable
enable.desc: Enable or disable node for render.

set-animation-blend.display-text: Set animation blend time to [i]{0}[/i] seconds

animation-names.description: Get animation names as JSON string.

use-bone-bounding-box.description: Returns 1 if bone-based bounding box is enabled, 0 if using static bounding box.

node-world-position.description: Get world position of a node as JSON string {x, y, z}. Works for any scene node.

node-name.name: Node name
node-name.desc: Name of the node to get position from.

node-world-position-x.description: Get the X component of a node's world position.

node-name.name: Node name
node-name.desc: Name of the node to get X position from.

node-world-position-y.description: Get the Y component of a node's world position.

node-name.name: Node name
node-name.desc: Name of the node to get Y position from.

node-world-position-z.description: Get the Z component of a node's world position.

node-name.name: Node name
node-name.desc: Name of the node to get Z position from.

bone-world-position.description: Get world position of a bone/joint as JSON string {x, y, z}. For tracking skeletal animation bones.

bone-name.name: Bone name
bone-name.desc: Name of the bone/joint to get position from.

bone-world-position-x.description: Get the X component of a bone's world position.

bone-name.name: Bone name
bone-name.desc: Name of the bone/joint to get X position from.

bone-world-position-y.description: Get the Y component of a bone's world position.

bone-name.name: Bone name
bone-name.desc: Name of the bone/joint to get Y position from.

bone-world-position-z.description: Get the Z component of a bone's world position.

bone-name.name: Bone name
bone-name.desc: Name of the bone/joint to get Z position from.

bone-names.description: Get list of all bone/joint names as JSON array string.

node-names.description: Get list of all node names as JSON array string.

effective-animation-rate.description: The animation update rate actually in use: the rate set by 'Set animation rate' after the distance-based factor. Equals AnimationRate when the distance feature is off or the model is within the min distance.
